question.text: Under Regulation 292K of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018, the draft fund-raising document for a Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) issuance by a Not-for-Profit Organization must contain minimum disclosures across multiple heads. Which of the following combinations represents REQUIRED minimum-disclosure heads as per the regulation?

answer.text: Vision; Target Segment; Strategy; Governance; Finance; Social Impact; Risks
Vision; Target Segment; Promoter Net Worth; Underwriting Arrangement; Credit Rating
Strategy; Cost of Borrowing; Debt Service Coverage; Asset Cover; Debenture Trustee
Target Segment; Secondary Market Liquidity Plan; Market-Maker Commitment; Price Band

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 292K lists the minimum disclosures an SSE must ensure in the issuance document: Vision, Target Segment, Strategy, Governance, Management, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Credibility, Social Impact and Risks. ZCZPs carry no coupon and no principal redemption, so credit-rating, DSCR, asset-cover and price-band disclosures applicable to conventional debt are NOT part of the 292K scheme. The Trap: Options referencing credit rating, DSCR, asset cover, underwriting, market-maker and price band are lifted from mainstream debt / IPO disclosure regimes (SEBI ICDR Schedule VI, SEBI NCS Regulations) and do not apply to ZCZP because there is nothing to repay. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C Compliance exams cover issue-document disclosures for listed debt/equity; XV Research Analyst covers issuer-disclosure reading for valuation. XXIII frames 292K as the SIA's checklist when scoping a pre-issuance engagement for a NPO. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Before accepting a ZCZP pre-issuance advisory engagement, walk through the 11-head 292K checklist with the NPO's CFO in a one-hour kickoff. Gaps on Credibility (12AB, FCRA, 80G certificates) and Finance (three-year audited statements) are the commonest reasons a draft returns from SSE for re-filing.
